en.name: Onion powder
en.summary: Onion powder keeps 3–4 years from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Like garlic powder it fades slowly and cakes quickly: moisture, not time, is what usually ends a jar.
en.pantry: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar, cool, dark and dry. The water has been driven out of the onion, so nothing can grow in the powder, and the sulphur compounds that carry its savoury smell hold up better than the delicate oils in dried herbs — hence a figure in years rather than months. The problem is humidity. Onion powder is one of the most hygroscopic things in the spice rack, and a jar kept above the kettle will set into a solid block in a single humid summer.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for onion powder, and the fridge is close to the worst place you could put it. Every time a cold jar is opened in a warm kitchen, condensation lands in it, and this is a powder that cakes at the first hint of moisture. Keep it sealed in a dry cupboard, which is what the published figure assumes.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either, and freezing makes the caking worse. There is very little to gain in any case: three to four years is already at the long end of the spice rack. If your jar has set hard, that is moisture damage rather than spoilage — break it up with a fork, and consider dropping a few grains of rice into the jar to take up humidity.
en.thawing: Not applicable — onion powder is a dry cupboard spice and should not be frozen.
spoilage: A jar set into a solid block from absorbed moisture.
Little or no smell when you warm a pinch in your palm.
Darkening from pale cream to yellow-brown.
Mould or a musty smell in a jar that got genuinely wet.
tips: Use a dry spoon; a wet one turns the jar to concrete within weeks.
Keep it away from the kettle and the hob.
Add a few grains of rice in a humid climate.
Break up a caked jar with a fork rather than throwing it away.

faq.q: How long does onion powder keep?
faq.a: 3–4 years from purchase in an airtight jar in a cool, dark, dry cupboard.

faq.q: My onion powder has gone solid. Can I still use it?
faq.a: Usually yes. Caking is moisture damage, not spoilage. Break it up with a fork and keep the jar drier; only a musty or mouldy jar should be thrown out.
No. It is extremely hygroscopic and the fridge is humid, so it will cake. A sealed jar in a dry cupboard is far better.

zh.name: 洋蔥粉
zh.summary: 洋蔥粉自購買日起，放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃可放 3～4 年。和蒜粉一樣，它退得慢、結塊卻很快：通常終結一罐的是濕氣，不是時間。
zh.pantry: 氣密罐、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 3～4 年。洋蔥裡的水已經被趕走，粉裡長不出東西；而帶來那股鹹香的含硫化合物，也比乾燥香草裡那些纖細的精油耐放——所以它的數字以年計而不是以月計。問題出在濕度。洋蔥粉是香料架上最會吸濕的東西之一，放在熱水壺上方的一罐，一個潮濕的夏天就足以讓它結成一塊硬磚。
zh.fridge: 洋蔥粉沒有公布的冷藏期限，而冰箱幾乎是你能放的最糟位置。冰過的罐子每次在溫暖廚房打開，水氣就落進去；而這是一種一有水氣就結塊的粉。請密封放乾燥櫥櫃，那正是公布數字預設的條件。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據，而且只會讓結塊更嚴重。何況也沒什麼好賺：三到四年已經是香料架上很長的那一端了。如果整罐結成硬塊，那是受潮而不是腐敗——用叉子敲散即可；潮濕地區可以丟幾粒米進罐子幫忙吸濕。
zh.thawing: 不適用——洋蔥粉是乾燥的櫥櫃香料，不應冷凍。
spoilage: 在手心搓熱一小撮，幾乎聞不到味道。
真的進水的罐子長霉或有霉味。
tips: 用乾湯匙；濕的舀一次，幾週內整罐就變水泥。
潮濕地區丟幾粒米進罐子。
結塊的用叉子敲散，不必整罐丟掉。

faq.a: 氣密罐放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 3～4 年。

faq.q: 洋蔥粉結成硬塊還能用嗎？
faq.a: 通常可以。結塊是受潮而不是腐敗，用叉子敲散、之後保持乾燥即可；只有有霉味或發霉的才該丟。
不要。它極會吸濕，而冰箱潮濕，冰了就會結塊。密封罐放乾燥櫥櫃好得多。
